Delay between visiting URLs (reduces server load).

Maximum number of pages to scrape.

How many pages to fetch at once. Keep 1 for delicate sites; request pacing still applies.
Hung pages fail after this many milliseconds, are retried with backoff, then logged as errors instead of stalling the whole crawl.
Comma separated; * is a wildcard. Empty = follow everything.
Merge updates rows whose key column matches; append adds everything; replace starts fresh.
Save progress downloads the remaining queue plus everything scraped so far. Resume reloads that file and continues without re-fetching visited pages.
